responsibility: This is the top-level machine description for the H8/300 backend. It defines target-wide RTL constants, attributes, condition-code substitutions, delay-slot rules, mode and code iterators, and the include structure that assembles all subordinate instruction fragments, thereby serving as the central specification of how H8 instructions are modeled for recognition, length computation, scheduling attributes, and compare-elimination support across the port.
same_name_distinction: Unlike h8300.cc's C++ support code, h8300.h's macro-based target configuration, and h8300.opt's command-line option definitions, this file is the declarative RTL machine description that defines H8 instruction patterns, attributes, iterators, delay-slot rules, and the include structure for subordinate .md fragments.
